name: talksmith
description: Presenter Agent for talks and pitches. Takes raw sources (PDFs, papers, chat exports, URLs, images) through an 8-step workflow — Frame → Collect → Corpus → Draft → Review → Polish → Render → Learnings — to a structured outline you edit (draft.md), a polished deliverable (final.md), and a self-contained HTML/Reveal.js deck. That deck is the source of truth for how a slide looks; a printable PDF and an editable .pptx are measured from it by laying it out in a headless browser, so all three agree by construction. Diagrams are authored as ASCII and rendered to SVG under blind visual critique.
